title: Google sign-in users land on My Account with no phone number and skip WooCommerce form hooks
symptoms: No Continue with Google button on WooCommerce login or register forms
New social users have an empty billing phone
Registration hooks that read $_POST do not run their form logic
cause: The free Nextend plugin does not inject its button into WooCommerce forms. Social logins return email and name only, never a phone, and send a new user to the account page. Code that reads posted form fields on user_register sees no form post.
fix: Render the button with its shortcode on the WooCommerce form hooks, add a phone capture step for logged-in users with no phone, and do not gate list signups on posted form fields.
affected: Nextend Social Login free with WooCommerce, September 2026
